summary: Validated the full VALEO refactor end-to-end (backend + frontend) on the deployed preview after resetting to an empty state via /api/admin/state. FLUX 1 (Créer une coopérative → Patron dashboard lime green): OK. FLUX 2 (add planteur with idNumber, village, cultures via CulturesPicker, tel): OK, planteur appears in list. FLUX 3 (MemberDetail Modifier/Supprimer): testIDs member-edit + member-delete present and functional, edit sheet pre-filled with existing values; delete confirm modal exposes testID confirm-yes / confirm-cancel. FLUX 4 (Équipe → +Ajouter): correct labels shown — 'Pisteur / Délégué' and 'Magasinier'; string 'Commis péseur' is nowhere in the DOM. Created both a Pisteur and a Magasinier successfully. FLUX 5 (PisteurRecon & CommisDetail Modifier/Supprimer): staff-edit + staff-delete testIDs present, delete flows through the same confirm-yes/confirm-cancel modal. FLUX 6 (FAB balance → Pesée): 'Produit pesé' proposes only the member's registered cultures (verified Cacao chip appears when member has Cacao); poids/prix accepted, Valider generates Bordereau with 'NET À PAYER'. FLUX 7 (Prêts): only visible to Patron via Coop tab → Prêts; 'Nouveau prêt / créance' opens LoanSheet with Select planteur, motif chips, amount; approve testID loan-approve-<id> opens LoanApproveSheet with granted-amount input (≤ demande, blocked otherwise) and Espèces/Mobile Money toggle → 'Approuver & verser' persists loan status='approuve'; refuse testID loan-refuse-<id> present. FLUX 8 (visibility): Magasinier sees ALL planteurs (testID nav-planteurs) but 'Mes pesées' shows only his own (empty when patron did the pesée), and has NO nav-coop button (no access to prêts). Pisteur sees his tournée and no nav-coop button. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_valeo_api.py (public GET/PUT /api/state, admin login/logout/state, admin dashboard HTML). No red screen, no console errors, no deprecated Expo packages observed. Refactor wiring is COMPLETE and CORRECT.
action_items: None — all 8 requested FLUX plus the backend health/state APIs pass. Safe to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx wiring is clean: editMember/editCollab state + MemberSheet/CollaborateurSheet initial prop enables the pre-fill flow; store.updateMember/updateStaff/deleteMember/deleteStaff exist and are called with the correct id.
PatronPrets exposes testID loan-approve-<id> and loan-refuse-<id>, and LoanApproveSheet validates granted ≤ requested amount before enabling submit — matches spec.
Confirmation modal in index.tsx uses a shared confirm-yes/confirm-cancel testID pair, reused for both planteur and staff deletion — no duplication.

Role labels updated everywhere: 'Pisteur / Délégué' in Collaborateurs, CollaborateurSheet, PisteurRecon, and 'Magasinier' replaces 'Commis péseur' in Collaborateurs + CommisDetail + CollaborateurSheet — full-text search of the deployed bundle finds no 'Commis péseur'.

PeseeSheet.cropChoices correctly narrows to memberCultures(member).map(c=>c.cropId) so 'Produit pesé' only lists that planteur's cultures (falls back to full CROPS list only when member has none registered).
